name: list_snippets
title: List snippets
description: Lists the user's snippets, or searches them by name, trigger and content. Returns ids, triggers, a short preview and how often each was used.

query.description: Words to search for in names, triggers and content.

group.description: Only snippets in this group (id, name or path like "Work/Email"), including its subgroups.

name: get_snippet
title: Read a snippet
description: Returns one snippet's full template, triggers, settings and fill-in fields. Pass its id or one of its triggers.

trigger.description: One of the snippet's triggers, such as ";sig".

name: expand_snippet
title: Expand a snippet
description: Renders a snippet as if the user typed its trigger now: dates, nested snippets and the clipboard are filled in. Fill-in fields take `values`; missing ones use their defaults.

values.description: Fill-in field values by field name.

name: list_groups
title: List groups
description: Lists the folders snippets are organized in, with their paths and snippet counts.

name: create_snippet
title: Create a snippet
description: Adds a snippet to the user's library. It works in every app right away. Triggers conventionally start with "{prefix}" (for example "{prefix}addr") and must not already be in use. Only create snippets the user asked for.

content.description: The template: text plus optional {{tags}} (see the server instructions).

triggers.description: What the user types to expand it.

group.description: Group id, name or path ("Work/Email"). Missing groups are created.

fireMode.description: immediate (default) expands as soon as the trigger is typed; wholeWord waits for a space or punctuation.

caseMode.description: propagate (default) matches ;Sig and ;SIG and adapts the output's case; exact matches only as written.

name: update_snippet
title: Edit a snippet
description: Changes an existing snippet. Pass its id and only the fields to change. Content of formatted snippets, and of snippets that hold a password or key, can only be edited in Kudzu.

group.description: Group id, name or path; null or "" moves it out of any group.

name: list_clipboard
title: Search clipboard history
description: Lists what the user copied recently, newest first, with the app it came from. Passwords, keys and tokens are withheld.

query.description: Words to search for in the copied text, file paths and app names.

name: get_clipboard_item
title: Read a clipboard item
description: Returns the full text of one clipboard history item (list results are shortened).
